tagData.title: alerts
tagData.name: Alerts
tagData.description: Different types of Bootstrap alert snippets for - success, info, warning, error etc. With our Bootstrap alerts you can give your project that professional touch it needs to look great on the web!. It's really simple to use, just copy the code snippet, paste it into your page and done. You can choose from 16 different types of alerts, success, info, warning and error.
